bodies.what_to_report: Private health, life, and property insurance companies.
bodies.legal_threshold: Investigates consumer complaints, conducts market conduct examinations, and can levy fines and penalties against insurance companies. Administers the state's external review program for health insurance denials.

bodies.oversight_body: Colorado HCPF — Health First Colorado Managed Care
bodies.what_to_report: Health First Colorado (Medicaid) managed care plans.
bodies.legal_threshold: Oversees the state's Medicaid managed care program, including handling grievances and appeals from beneficiaries.

bodies.what_to_report: Housing discrimination under the Colorado Anti-Discrimination Act (CADA).
bodies.legal_threshold: Investigates complaints of housing discrimination based on race, sex, disability, familial status, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, and marital status.

bodies.oversight_body: Colorado DLSS — Division of Labor Standards and Statistics
bodies.what_to_report: Wage and hour laws, including the Colorado Wage Claim Act (CWCA).
bodies.legal_threshold: Investigates wage complaints, enforces minimum wage and overtime laws, and can recover unpaid wages and penalties for workers.

bodies.what_to_report: Employment discrimination under the Colorado Anti-Discrimination Act (CADA).
bodies.legal_threshold: Investigates complaints of employment discrimination based on race, sex, disability, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, and creed.

bodies.what_to_report: Appeals of public assistance benefit denials, terminations, or reductions.
bodies.legal_threshold: Conducts fair hearings for SNAP, Health First Colorado, and Colorado Works cases.

bodies.what_to_report: Appeals of unemployment insurance benefit decisions.
bodies.legal_threshold: Conducts hearings on UI eligibility and appeals.

bodies.what_to_report: Law enforcement officers in Colorado.
bodies.legal_threshold: Certifies and decertifies peace officers in Colorado, and investigates misconduct that could lead to decertification.

bodies.oversight_body: HUD Fair Housing — Denver Regional Office
bodies.what_to_report: Federal Fair Housing Act violations.
bodies.legal_threshold: Investigates complaints of housing discrimination under federal law.

bodies.what_to_report: Federal employment discrimination laws.
bodies.legal_threshold: Investigates complaints of employment discrimination under federal law.

bodies.oversight_body: DOL Wage and Hour Division — Denver
bodies.what_to_report: Federal wage and hour laws, including the Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA).
bodies.legal_threshold: Enforces federal minimum wage, overtime, and child labor laws.

bodies.oversight_body: Denver Office of the Independent Monitor (OIM)
bodies.what_to_report: Denver Police and Sheriff Departments.
bodies.legal_threshold: Provides independent oversight of the Denver Police and Sheriff Departments, including investigating misconduct and making recommendations for systemic change.

bodies.name: Colorado Medical Board
bodies.complaint_pathway: File complaint with state medical board
bodies.what_to_report: Prescribing violations, polypharmacy harm, medication mismanagement, physician misconduct

bodies.name: Colorado Patient Advocacy
bodies.what_to_report: Patient rights violations, family exclusion from care decisions, informed consent issues

bodies.name: Colorado Department of Health
bodies.complaint_pathway: File complaint with state health department
bodies.what_to_report: Healthcare facility complaints, public health violations, licensing concerns

bodies.name: HHS Office for Civil Rights
bodies.what_to_report: HIPAA violations, medical records access denial, privacy breaches, discrimination in healthcare

bodies.name: Colorado Board of Pharmacy
bodies.complaint_pathway: File complaint with state pharmacy board
bodies.what_to_report: Medication dispensing errors, drug interaction failures, pharmacy practice violations

bodies.name: Colorado Protection & Advocacy
bodies.what_to_report: Rights violations during psychiatric holds, restraint/seclusion abuse, denial of legal rights

bodies.name: Colorado Mental Health Authority
bodies.what_to_report: Involuntary commitment violations, patient rights violations, facility conditions, treatment concerns

bodies.name: The Joint Commission
bodies.what_to_report: Hospital accreditation violations, patient safety concerns, restraint/seclusion policy violations
